meta.name: Puzzle 01 — Build a Beacon
meta.description: SOLO PUZZLE. Player has a Block already on the dish. Goal: create a Beacon (period-2 oscillator) in 1 move by placing a second Block diagonally adjacent to the existing one. Teaches that named Conway patterns can be built from simpler ones.
meta.rules: Solo mode. Prompt: 'Build a period-2 oscillator in 1 move.' advanceSteps=1 per turn so player visibly sees the beacon flipping between its two states. Win check: final state has 6 or 8 cells in beacon configuration.
questions: With advanceSteps=1, does the oscillation feel legible?
Is the aha moment (two blocks → beacon) discoverable via ghost preview?
Is this a satisfying 'first puzzle' or too trivial?

moves.note: Player places a second Block diagonally adjacent to the given one.
Step 1: inner corner cells die. Beacon now in state B (6 cells).
Step 2: state A returns (8 cells). Period-2 oscillation visible.
